summary: Cred presents a solo episode focused on Bitcoin's continued strength following an all-time high breakout. He recommends owning BTC as a hedge against missing a potential corporate treasury bubble and credit expansion cycle. The key technical invalidation is the low of the weekly breakout candle - if that gets taken out, it would resemble the 2021 failed breakout pattern. Cred strongly advises against catch-up trades into altcoins or weaker assets, emphasizing that 'strong stays strong' in this dispersion cycle. For those who missed the breakout, he suggests either buying spot BTC regardless of price or using low timeframe trading strategies.
key_takeaways: Own BTC as a 'mental illness hedge' - not having exposure during a potential bubble can impair trading decisions
Avoid catch-up trades into altcoins - strong assets stay strong, weak assets stay weak in dispersion cycles
Nearest invalidation is the weekly breakout candle low - a return there would signal 2021-style failed breakout
Immediate pullbacks to breakout origin are bearish - if strong, market shouldn't give back impulse gains quickly
Use low timeframe trading when high timeframes are in lockout mode - 5min/15min offers entries when daily/weekly don't
